messages:
Harper: Random thought  DIY slider showdown + tabletop shelf-swap this Thursday after 5? Small contest (best mini-slider) + bring-a-game exchange. :hamburger::game_die:
Zane: Love it. What time? 5:30ish?
Harper: 5:30 meet in the kitchen, quick prep table, then we can set up game swap on the lounge shelf.
Raya: Ill bring slider buns and a vegan patty option. Count me in.
Tom: I can do condiments + a tiny grill pan. Also bringing two old Catan expansion boxes for the swap.
Harper: Ops check: is kitchen OK for ephemeral cooking? ops-bot: Reminder: light food prep in shared kitchen okay if you follow safety guidelines: https://intranet/redwood/office-guidelines
ops-bot: Facilities note: groups >8 should file a facilities request. Link: https://intranet/redwood/facilities-request
Zane: Good to know. Let's cap at 10 so we keep it cozy.
Raya: Quick poll: "Slider Contest" vs "Just Swap"  react :trophy: or :recycle:
Harper: I'll tally votes and post a tiny bracket if it's contest mode.
Tom: I can handle a $10 prize (coffee shop voucher) for the winner.
Zane: I'll manage napkins/plates.
Harper: If anyone wants to donate games to the shelf, please label them "swap" and leave in the lounge bin. No broken components pls.
Raya: Partners ok? Might bring mine; fine if we hit cap?
Harper: Partners welcome but rooftop/kitchen cap rules apply. First-come RSVP wins.
ops-bot: Event placeholder created: "DIY Slider Showdown + Game Swap" on calendar for 2026-03-26 17:30. Facilities request not required for <=10 attendees.
Harper: Sweet. Tentative: Thu 5:30, kitchen meet, BYO game to swap, small contest if enough votes. See you Thursday! :raised_hands:
